email.subject1: a signal play for Reggora's partners
email.body1:
Jacob, saw Reggora acquired Appraeze and is rolling out a 24-hour appraisal product after the $18M raise.

Moves like that open more co-sell motion across your lender and vendor ecosystem than the team can cover by hand, and partner-sourced pipeline stalls when nobody can work every account at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and sequences across the ecosystem with zero rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Reggora's partner ecosystem off your tech-stack signals, accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

email.body2:
Jacob, quick follow-up for Reggora.

Co-sell pipeline usually depends on a few partners doing manual intros, so coverage across the full ecosystem stays thin and partner-sourced numbers plateau. There is a faster way to cover every joint account without hiring.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body3:
Jacob, last bit of proof for Reggora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reggora's reply rate likely compares to other mortgage-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jacob, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. An acquisition plus a launch keeps a team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to your partner ecosystem? I'll tailor it to Reggora either way.
